decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: README defines dataset.json fields (id, instruction, spreadsheet_path, instruction_type, answer_position) and spreadsheet naming. evaluation.py loads ../data/{dataset}/dataset.json and expects spreadsheets under spreadsheet/{id}/{No.}_{id}_answer.xlsx and _input.xlsx. parity_test uses same pattern.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Cell metric is equality after transform_value with rounding and datetime handling plus empty/None equivalence. Per-test-case result is True/False. Per-task: soft_restriction is fraction of passed test cases; hard_restriction is 1 if all three pass else 0. parity_test defines identical soft/hard.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: README describes evaluation entrypoint and scripts. evaluation.py fully implements comparison of workbooks, cell ranges, and aggregation into JSON. open_spreadsheet.py implements cross-platform formula recalculation to enable reliable evaluation.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: Rules: all cells in specified ranges must match; types must match after transform_value; empty string and None are treated equal. For multiple ranges, all must pass (all(result_list)). Exceptions during comparison count as failure. Per-task soft/hard computed; parity_test shows dataset-level summation without special tie-breaking.

decisions.label: documented-and-verifiable
decisions.evidence_note: README states model outputs saved under data/.../outputs. evaluation.py (commented proc_path) shows expected naming for output spreadsheets; currently it compares *_input.xlsx for demonstration. Per-task metrics are written to eval_*.json. parity_test shows aggregating soft/hard over all tasks via sums divided by task count.
